sources.title: Cruzer (by Crafter) EF-DT Distortion | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Effects Database has an exact record for the Cruzer (by Crafter) EF-DT Distortion. The page identifies the pedal as a 2009 NAMM model from Crafter and describes a rugged steel enclosure with analog circuitry using modern components. It says the EF-DT provides modern distortion effects and uses buffered bypass for silent switching and tone preservation. The record also links to Crafter documentation and related pedals that share the same product family.
